Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against pyruvate kinase PKM (CHEMBL1075189). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target CHEMBL ID and assay organism. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
